free_tier.stated: No ongoing free tier. The sign-up page offers a 7-day free trial on the periodic plans: 'Your 7-day free trial is completely risk free - no payment information needed.' The home page also states a 7-day money-back guarantee. The trial's own limits are not stated.
free_tier.notes: The FAQ states that free trial accounts cannot post to Usenet; posting is enabled on paid packages.

retention.stated: The vendor FAQ states 4,500+ days: 'Our platform currently retains Usenet messages that are more than 4,500 days old.' The third-party r/usenet map gives a lower figure, which does not match the vendor.

egress.terms: No download limit on the periodic plans; block accounts carry a download limit; with one friend or family member; posting enabled by default on paid packages

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
chaining: Stacks as a cheap fill or as a low-cost primary for recent content; the ASN it shares with UsenetExpress makes it a weaker second feed than its independence suggests.

limits.value: 5 connections on VIPER10 (10 Mbit/s), 20 on VIPER50 (50 Mbit/s), 40 on VIPERUNL (unlimited speed) and on the block accounts
soft 5 TB/month on unlimited plans, reset on request via support - reported, not on the vendor page
4,500+ days per the vendor FAQ; the third-party r/usenet map gives a lower figure

limits_note: Periodic plans start at $1.79/mo (VIPER10), $2.69/mo (VIPER50) and $3.59/mo (VIPERUNL) when billed yearly. Block accounts do not expire: 500GB $13.99, 1000GB $23.99 and 2000GB $42.99, each a one-time payment.
binding_note: The vendor publishes no volume cap; the reported soft ceiling is 5 TB/month, which 1 TiB/month does not reach.

identity_cost.detail: Email address and password. The sign-up page states 'Your 7-day free trial is completely risk free - no payment information needed.' Paid plans take a credit card, PayPal or cryptocurrencies; automatic renewal is not supported with cryptocurrencies.

reliability_note: Independent Dutch platform (ViperNews B.V., formerly mapped as Uzo Reto) that has shared an ASN with UsenetExpress since 2023, which makes it a less independent second feed than it looks.
confidence_note: Prices, plan limits, retention and the free trial are vendor-stated and were read on 2026-11-03. Only the monthly soft cap is third-party (r/usenet); the vendor publishes no download limit on the periodic plans.
